summary: This Form 6-K by Logistic Properties of the Americas (LPA) is a routine earnings release for Q1 2026, reporting financial and operating results such as a 21.6% revenue increase and 100% occupancy. There is no special-situation event like an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review. The filing merely announces quarterly performance and provides supplemental information, which is typical for a foreign private issuer's ongoing reporting. No deal terms or special circumstances are present.
